entries.title: Revelation of John 9:1
segments: Then the fifth angel blew; and I saw a Star that had fallen upon the earth from the heavens, and to him was given the key of the bottomless pit.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:2
segments: He opened the bottomless pit, and from the pit rose a smoke like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air grew dark because of the smoke from the pit.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:3
segments: Out of the smoke locusts descended upon the earth, and they received the same power as that possessed by scorpions.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:4
segments: They were told not to harm the grass, or any plant, or any tree, but only those who have not 'the seal of God upon their foreheads.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:5
segments: Yet they were not allowed to kill them, but it was ordered that those men should be tortured for five months. Their torture was like the torture caused by a scorpion when it stings a man.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:6
segments: In those days men 'will seek Death and will not find it'; They will long to die, but Death flees from them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:7
segments: In appearance the locusts were like horses equipped for battle. On their heads there were what appeared to be crowns that shone like gold, their faces resembled human faces,

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:8
segments: and they had hair like the hair of a woman, their teeth were like lions' teeth,

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:9
segments: and they had what seemed to be iron breastplates, while the noise of their wings was like the noise of chariots drawn by many horses, galloping into battle.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:10
segments: They have tails like scorpions, and stings, and in their tails lies their power to harm men for five months.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:11
segments: They have as their king the Angel of the bottomless pit, whose name, in Hebrew, is 'Abaddon,' while, in Greek, his name is 'Apollyon' (the Destroyer).

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:12
segments: The first Woe has passed; and still there are two Woes to follow!

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:13
segments: Then the sixth angel blew; and I heard a voice proceeding from the corners of the golden altar that stood before God.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:14
segments: It spoke to the sixth angel--the angel with the trumpet--and said 'Let loose the four angels that are in chains at the great river Euphrates.'

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:15
segments: Then the four angels, that were held in readiness for that hour and day and month and year, were let loose, to destroy a third of mankind.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:16
segments: The number of the hosts of horsemen was ten thousand times ten thousand, twice told; I heard their number.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:17
segments: And this is what the horses and their riders appeared to be like in my vision:--They had breastplates of fire, blood-red and sulphurous, and the heads of the horses were like lions' heads, while out of their mouths issue fire, and smoke, and sulphur.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:18
segments: Through these three Curses a third of mankind perished--because of the fire, and the smoke, and the sulphur that issued from their mouths;

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:19
segments: for the power of the horses lies in their mouths and in their tails.  For their tails are like snakes, with heads, and it is with them that they do harm.

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:20
segments: But those who were left of mankind, who had not perished through these Curses, did not repent and turn away from what their own hands had made; they would not abandon the worship of 'demons, and of idols made of gold or silver or brass or stone or wood, which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk';

entries.title: Revelation of John 9:21
segments: and they did not repent of their murders, or their sorceries, or their licentiousness, or their thefts.
